final_message:
Yen receipts now show correctly: `Paid ¥500 by card`. The yen receipt test passes, along with the other 17 tests.

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a zero-decimal currency set containing `JPY`. Those currencies now print the amount as it is.

`formatMoney` is shared by invoices, payments, cart and admin, so yen amounts in those places now display correctly too. Nothing else in the repo handles yen specially, and no other tests use it.
